notes: Scrapper Clans: a patched pressure vessel, mismatched plates, hazard tape, a leaking pipe (steam puffs and a falling drip on the loop), a flickering amber core in a window with a rust patch over one corner. Damaged: the vessel patch has popped its bolts and hangs, the core hiccups, wire ends spit sparks, the drip becomes a stream. Disabled: dead core, the vessel split open along the weld with the patch plate fallen off, a dark leak pool. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
